A.notes: A has a coherent quiet identity: the giant wordmark, brick fields, slit-of-light motif and annotated plans all support the brief. The typography is elegant and the project drawings are clear, but the motion reads as mostly reveal/highlight behavior from the frame strip rather than a stronger scroll narrative, and some mobile/list details feel less refined than the desktop.

B.notes: B has the stronger single idea: brick, light and courtyard are present immediately in the hero arch and continue through the project images, plans and section structure. Type carries the identity beautifully and the scroll sequence appears purposeful, but the normal full-page capture shows large blank gaps where content seems hidden until scrolled, which hurts craft even though reduced-motion and measured checks are solid.

raw.why: B expresses the brief more clearly and memorably across hero, projects and plans, despite A being cleaner in the fully visible long-page view.
